description: Build a personal study plan for one EduAvenues course from the student's own knowledge-check scores and lesson progress: the weakest lessons to review first (lowest score first), checks to take, lessons to finish, what comes next, how each section stands, and whether an EduAvenues coach should step in. For a parent with several enrolled children, returns one plan per student. Answers questions like "what should I work on", "where is my child struggling", or "are they on track".

courseId.description: EduAvenues course id from list_my_courses (for example "tj-prep")

name: what_to_study
title: What should I study next
